theme_strategy.description: Executive High-Contrast ERP Hybrid: Deep Navy structural rail (#0B1329 / #0F172A) paired with a crisp warm cream/bone-white content workspace (#F8FAFC / #F1F5F9). Accentuated by Warm Industrial Amber/Ochre (#D97706 / #F59E0B / #B45309) for active states, key CTAs, and level badges. Built faithfully to the screenshot specifications.

scale_hierarchy.h1_page_title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
scale_hierarchy.h2_card_title: text-lg sm:text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
scale_hierarchy.h3_section_subtitle: text-sm sm:text-base font-semibold tracking-normal text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300
scale_hierarchy.h4_field_group: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400
scale_hierarchy.code_pill: font-mono text-xs font-medium tracking-tight px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-amber-400 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700

rules: Never exceed text-3xl for enterprise dashboard headers to avoid visual screaming.
Requisition codes, IDs, and financial amounts (BDT) must always use font-mono for tabular visual alignment.
Overline labels on forms and KPI tiles must use uppercase with tracking-wider and text-xs.

contrast_matrix.sidebar_active: Amber (#D97706) with crisp White text: APCA compliant (4.6:1+ WCAG AA).
contrast_matrix.pill_yes_badge: Soft Emerald Green (#DCFCE7 bg with #15803D text) for 'CAN RAISE PR' table column.
contrast_matrix.approval_priority_badge: Deep Amber (#F59E0B) with dark badge outline for 'Level 01 - Department Head'.

shell_structure.sidebar: Fixed left rail, width 260px (collapsible to 72px icon mode or mobile slide-out drawer). Background: Deep Navy (#070E20).
shell_structure.header: Top sticky navigation bar (h-16), background #FFFFFF / #0F172A with border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800. Non-transparent background with backdrop blur.
shell_structure.main_workspace: calc(100vw - 260px) flex-1 min-h-screen bg-[#F8FAFC] dark:bg-[#0B132B] p-6 lg:p-8 overflow-y-auto

new_requisition_form.header_card: Deep Navy dark card (#0C1733) with crisp white heading 'New Requisition', auto-generated Requisition ID pill 'REQ-2026-0842', Requisitioner pill with Avatar, and Requisition Date.
new_requisition_form.form_grid: Grid 12-cols: Left 8-cols for Requisition Particulars + Items Table + Requester Note; Right 4-cols for Approval Priority Chain + Attachments Upload + Submission Summary.
new_requisition_form.item_entry_row: Inline responsive form: Requisition Type (Product/Service), Product Type (Asset/Consumable), Product Name input, Quantity counter, Remarks, and an Amber 'Add Product' Button.
new_requisition_form.items_table: Card with interactive items table (or empty state illustration when 0 items added), subtotal calculator, and remove row action.

users_and_roles_table.toolbar: Search filter input, Role dropdown filter, Department dropdown filter, and Amber 'New User' modal trigger button.
users_and_roles_table.table_grid: Columns: NAME (with avatar + user title), EMAIL, DEPARTMENT, ROLE, CAN RAISE PR (Badge: Yes/No), ACTIONS (Edit icon, Delete icon, Permissions key icon).

approval_chain_card.hierarchy_timeline: Vertical step indicators showing Level 01: Dept Head -> Level 02: IT Head -> Level 03: Accounts -> Level 04: MD (if >= 50k BDT) -> Level 05: Purchase Head. Service bypass logic visually highlighted.

visual_enhancers.card_styles: Clean 1px borders (border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800), rounded-xl, subtle layered shadow (shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200).
visual_enhancers.sidebar_keyboard_badges: Custom kbd badge tags (e.g., '⌘1', '⌘2' or counter badges) in the sidebar items as seen in modern operator cockpits.
visual_enhancers.approval_pill: Rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider inline-flex items-center gap-1.5
visual_enhancers.active_indicator: Left-accent 3px solid #F59E0B bar or rounded amber background button (#D97706) with crisp white icon.

accessibility_and_contrast.keyboard_nav: Full arrow and tab indexing across sidebar collapsible sections and table action dropdowns
accessibility_and_contrast.color_blind_support: Status badges must feature both an icon (Check, Clock, X, AlertCircle) and text label, not color alone
accessibility_and_contrast.test_id_convention: All inputs, action buttons, table rows, and status indicators must carry semantic data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="btn-add-product", data-testid="input-req-type", data-testid="table-users-row-1")

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Adhere strictly to the attached screenshot layouts: Dark navy sidebar navigation, clean light cream/slate workspace, deep navy card header for New Requisition, and warm amber (#D97706 / #F59E0B) for active items & primary buttons.

2. Implement dynamic role-based navigation: Menu groups (Dashboard, Requisition, Stock, Purchase, Handover, Approvals, Organization). Admin sees all, Dept Head sees Approvals & Department Requisitions, Regular Employee sees New Requisition & My Requisitions.

3. New Requisition Form: Support adding multiple items before final submit. Fields must match: Requisition Type (Product/Service), Product Type (Asset/Consumable), Product Name, Quantity (with increment/decrement buttons), Remarks, and 'Add Product' button.
4. Auto-generate Requisition Number in format 'REQ-2026-XXXX' (e.g., REQ-2026-0842) with a distinct monospace pill in the navy header.

5. Approval Chain Visualizer: Implement dynamic rule calculation - Product goes to Dept Head -> IT Head -> Accounts -> MD (if total amount >= 50,000 BDT) -> Purchase Head. Service requisitions direct straight to IT Dept Head.

6. Users & Roles Table: Replicate the table from screenshot #3 with NAME, EMAIL, DEPARTMENT, ROLE, CAN RAISE PR (emerald badge 'Yes' / gray badge 'No'), and action buttons (Edit, Delete, Role Permissions). Include search and filter by department.

7. Mock data must be comprehensive and realistic: Include IT assets (MacBook Pro M3, Dell UltraSharp 27 Monitor, Ergonomic Chair, Cisco Switch) and consumables (Cat6 Cables, Wireless Mouse, Toner Cartridge).
8. Use Sonner toasts for instant feedback upon adding products, submitting requisitions, changing user permissions, and approving requests.
9. Use .js and .jsx files with Tailwind CSS classes. Do not use TypeScript .tsx files as this project is configured for pure JavaScript React.
10. Ensure EVERY button, input, badge, table row, and tab includes an explicit data-testid attribute for automated testing.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Avoid generic SaaS blue dashboards. Stick faithfully to the screenshot's distinctive Deep Navy (#070E20) and Amber (#D97706) pairing with high-legibility tabular fonts.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous breathing room: p-6 to p-8 inside cards, gap-6 in form grids, and h-12 table row heights.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Use specific transition properties like 'transition-colors duration-150' or 'transition-transform duration-200'. Never use 'transition: all'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.borders: Always use subtle 1px borders (border-slate-200 in light, border-slate-800 in dark) to keep panels crisp without looking heavy.
